races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden

runners_data.name: Bold Move
runners_data.note: Ran 7f at Goodwood twice, finishing 7th and 6th, showing some progression; genuine hold-up type that will likely find himself racing further forward than ideal in this compressed field, which tempers confidence in a big finish.

runners_data.name: Capability Brown
runners_data.note: Single run at 8f on Good at the Curragh finishing 6th; Jack Cleary takes the ride for AP O'Brien but this horse's natural desire to race from the rear will be compromised by the volume of similar types in this field.

runners_data.name: Closefield Beau
runners_data.note: Ran twice at 7f, finishing 7th at Goodwood and 10th on soft — a flag on soft going — and McLoughlin's runner will be squeezed into a more forward position than suits; the soft-going form profile is a concern independent of tactical issues.

runners_data.name: Consenza
runners_data.note: One run for Noel Meade, finishing 8th at 7f on Good at the Curragh with a fades-in-finish pattern flagged; will find itself racing in a busier midfield than its natural style demands, limiting the prospects of a strong late challenge.

runners_data.name: Dawnmore
runners_data.note: Bolger debutant ridden by Seamie Heffernan — that combination alone commands respect — going and trip are both unknown quantities but the booking and yard suggest a horse expected to be competitive from the front half of the field.

runners_data.name: Drumbeat
runners_data.note: Two runs for AP O'Brien, 3rd at 8f and 6th at 7f on Good, with an established prominent style; this race shape suits him as he can sit close to the pace set by Equus Victor and be produced off the bend over soft ground.

runners_data.name: Power Through
runners_data.note: Debutant for A Oliver with Gary Carroll, a yard with modest recent strike rate but Carroll is capable of getting unknown types into the race; complete unknown but no flagged concerns on going or trip.

runners_data.name: Snapequus
runners_data.note: Finished 11th at 7f on Good for Joseph O'Brien and fades in finish is noted; a cautionary profile for soft ground where the stamina demands are higher, and nothing in the form suggests improvement is imminent.

runners_data.name: The Captains Day
runners_data.note: Finished 4th at 7f on Good for M D O'Callaghan, ridden here by Colin Keane — a significant jockey booking that elevates this runner's claims; unknown style but the form is solid and Keane rarely takes mediocre rides in fields of this size.

runners_data.name: Verona Basilica
runners_data.note: Finished 9th at 8f for Donnacha Aidan O'Brien and fades late; dropping to 7f on softer ground is unlikely to reverse that pattern, and this appears to be a runner building experience rather than threatening here.

runners_data.name: Moon Sand
runners_data.note: Two runs finishing 9th each time at 8f on Good for Joseph O'Brien; this is a drop in trip with a pattern of weakening late, and the soft going will demand more stamina than the runner has shown it possesses.

runners_data.name: Don't Go Mad
runners_data.note: Finished 15th at 6f on Good for Ross O'Sullivan, a trainer with no wins in the last 14 days from 19 runners; nothing in the profile suggests competitiveness at this level over this longer trip on soft going.

runners_data.name: Equus Victor
runners_data.note: The only confirmed front-runner in the race; Ben Coen is a strong jockey booking for Daniel James Murphy, and while Equus Victor is 0-from-2, the soft ground at Gowran is not a concern and his ability to control the tempo from the front is the defining tactical fact of this race.

runners_data.name: Forthethrillofit
runners_data.note: Donnacha Aidan O'Brien debutant with Paddy Harnett taking the ride; the trainer strike rate of 3 from 17 is modest, and the apprentice booking is less compelling than some rivals' jockeys, though debut O'Brien runners always carry fitness doubt upside.

runners_data.name: How Now
runners_data.note: Debut runner for Conor David Maxwell, a small trainer with no wins in the last 14 days; complete unknown, and the trainer profile suggests this is more of a learning run than a winning expedition.

runners_data.name: Invincible Mind
runners_data.note: Another Joseph O'Brien debutant with J M Sheridan aboard; the stable has 12 winners from 72 runners in the last 14 days, a strong strike rate, and an unknown debutant from this yard on soft ground at 7f cannot be easily dismissed.

runners_data.name: King Paddy
runners_data.note: Two runs finishing 12th and 17th for Paul Flynn, who has one win from 16 runners in the current period; a fades-in-finish flag plus consistently poor form leaves this runner with little to recommend it tactically or on form.

runners_data.name: Lamar River
runners_data.note: 158 days since last run is a significant absence flag; two runs at 5f finishing 5th and 6th on similar going suggests the horse handles soft, but stepping up sharply in trip after a long layoff for a small trainer with no recent winners is a tough combination.

races.paceDynamic: Equus Victor is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 18-runner soft-ground maiden and, critically, faces no identified rival willing or able to press him from the start — he should settle into a comfortable, controlled gallop from the front without any serious challenge for the lead. With soft going at Gowran Park, the pace is unlikely to be breakneck, meaning Equus Victor can dictate terms and conserve energy, making life very difficult for horses that need a strong early tempo to wind up from behind. The field does contain more hold-up and prominent types than the pace map can physically accommodate at the rear — Consenza, Closefield Beau, Capability Brown, and Bold Move are all genuine hold-up horses that will find themselves racing in an uncharacteristically forward position, meaning the race will be more compressed in the middle than it appears, and late surges from true closers will be harder to deliver from a genuinely deep position. This race shape strongly favours horses who can travel prominently in behind Equus Victor — prominent racers with soft-ground stamina who can be produced in a controlled fashion off a sustainable pace — rather than horses attempting to make ground from the rear in soft ground off a non-pressured gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Equus Victor Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Equus Victor secures the lead unchallenged and the field settles into a single file on soft ground with no rival pressing him.
scenarios.body: Equus Victor sets a sensible, unhurried pace and the soft ground rewards galloping types who travel prominently; horses trying to close from the rear find the tempo insufficient to generate momentum.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Reels Him In
scenarios.trigger: If a prominent or forward-travelling type tracks Equus Victor comfortably through the race and proves stronger in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: The soft ground suits a horse with stamina that can sit second or third, expending minimal early energy before challenging off the bend; Drumbeat, who has run prominently before, or an unknown debutant with natural forward inclination is best placed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Debutant Lands Gamble From Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If a well-prepared debutant from a powerful stable (O'Brien, Bolger) travels through the race from midfield on the bridle and picks off the leaders.
scenarios.body: High-quality unknown quantities from top yards can bypass the usual pace dynamics on their racecourse debut, and soft ground on this 7f trip can bring a staying-bred type into play; the race becomes more open if Equus Victor's stamina dips in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves genuinely strong enough — against expectation — to fully string out the field and allow hold-up horses to close into a spent leader.
scenarios.body: This is the least likely shape given there is only one true front-runner and the hold-up horses are redistributed into midfield rather than racing from their natural position at the rear; any late finisher benefiting here does so more by stamina than a true sustained close.

watchPoints.text: Equus Victor — if Ben Coen is allowed to bowl along unchallenged from flag to finish on this soft ground, any horse without a prominent position will find it very difficult to reel him in before the line.

The Captains Day — Colin Keane does not take big-field maiden rides without a reason; watch the market move on this runner from M D O'Callaghan, as the jockey booking is the strongest signal in the race from a horse with credible prior form.

Dawnmore — Seamie Heffernan on a Bolger debutant is a combination that historically commands respect; unknown quantities from this yard can arrive fit and forward-going, and soft ground often suits a staying-bred type on debut.

Invincible Mind — Joseph O'Brien's stable is firing at a 17% strike rate over the last 14 days and this is their debutant runner; watch for any market support as the yard rarely wastes an entry in a competitive maiden without expectation.

The hold-up cluster (Consenza, Capability Brown, Bold Move, Closefield Beau) — all four will be racing further forward than their natural style, creating a more congested mid-pack than usual; watch for traffic issues on the turn and into the straight that could influence the result.

races.name: 1xBet.ie Proud Supporters Of Irish Racing Handicap

runners_data.name: Snow Light
runners_data.note: Front-runner who won over 7f on standard at Tipperary last time out but hasn't run in 278 days and faces four rivals intent on the same position; the layoff combined with the soft ground and pace battle makes it very hard to assess.|
runners_data.comment: Snow Light won last time out and has run over today's trip, giving her a solid profile, but 278 days off the track is the clear concern heading into this.

runners_data.name: Lohoobb
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won at Goodwood over 7f on good ground and returns just 20 days later in good form; a genuine closer who wants the pace to burn ahead of him, and this race almost certainly provides that — W J Lee is a strong tactical judge.|
runners_data.comment: Lohoobb won last time out and, with experience over today's trip and a fine edge in our ratings, he looks a genuine threat here; the main risk is whether 142 lb from stall 12 blunts his momentum.

runners_data.name: Motta Alta
runners_data.note: Front-runner with the most convincing soft-ground record in this field (1 win, 2 places from 3 soft starts), trained by Mrs Harrington who sends 2 from 31 runners in 14 days; Shane Foley will need to secure a prominent position early in a hot pace battle.|
runners_data.comment: Motta Alta shaped well when third last time out, and a winner two starts back, hinting at a filly in good heart; she has run over today's trip and going, and her rating of 88 makes her the one to beat here, albeit the 139 lb burden is worth noting.

runners_data.name: Solana Beach
runners_data.note: Prominent-tracking type with two soft-ground places from three starts, handled by Seamie Heffernan who excels at reading pace races; hasn't run in 81 days but the form base suggests she handles this ground well and won't be far off the speed.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last three starts, Solana Beach has nonetheless shown consistent placing form — second and third among those efforts — and has run over today's distance and going before; the 81-day absence and 138 lb burden are the questions she must answer here.

runners_data.name: Friendly Invoice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse flagged as fading in the finish, and the 200-day absence combined with a form string that shows just one win on standard ground at Naas raises serious stamina questions on today's soft surface.|
runners_data.comment: Friendly Invoice makes her return after a 200-day absence and ranks tenth of twelve on our figures, making her hard to fancy at this level; she does bring distance and going experience and showed ability when winning three starts back, but the lengthy layoff is a significant concern.

runners_data.name: Girl Bear
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up type whose best recent effort was a third over 8f, suggesting a longer trip may suit more than today's 7f; a form string of mostly mid-pack finishes on good ground gives no confidence on soft.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, with an eighth last time out and a seventh before that, Girl Bear faces a stiff ask from stall four, though her experience over today's trip and going and a return to action after 36 days at least gives connections something to work with.

runners_data.name: Cladach
runners_data.note: O'Brien's runner has genuine hold-up tendencies despite being mapped to midfield due to the volume of rear-runners in this field; flagged as fading in the finish and ran just 10 days ago, and the style mismatch with its likely map position tempers its chances.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, with an eighth and an unplaced effort in recent outings, Cladach looks hard to fancy on these figures, ranked 11 of 12 in the field; has run over today's trip before, and at least returns on a sharp turnaround of just 10 days.

runners_data.name: Glasarmi
runners_data.note: Front-runner who was pulled up at Goodwood on her last start and has produced a flat recent form string; 10 days since last run and soft ground are untested quantities, and she faces four rivals all wanting to lead.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last four starts and ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Glasarmi is hard to fancy, though she has run over today's distance and going before and returns on a quick ten-day turnaround.

runners_data.name: Star Strewn
runners_data.note: Front-runner whose only win came on standard at Tipperary and has struggled on good ground at Goodwood and Salisbury; the sole run on soft shows no form, the headgear entry is noted, and 130 days off adds further uncertainty.|
runners_data.comment: Star Strewn won three starts back but has since finished eighth and ninth, and 130 days off the track is a significant fitness question; she has run over today's trip and carries 136 lb from stall 11.

runners_data.name: Ninth Crusade
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse raced just one day ago which is a significant concern for energy reserves; best effort this season was a third over 7f on good ground at Curragh, and the combination of quick turnaround and soft ground makes assessment difficult despite Colin Keane's booking.|
runners_data.comment: Ninth Crusade is yet to win in his last five starts, though a third and a second among his recent efforts offer some encouragement; the concern is that he returns just one day after his latest unplaced effort, which makes a bounce-back harder to fancy.

runners_data.name: Nazario
runners_data.note: Prominent-tracking type who has placed on soft ground (second at Curragh over 6f) and wears a t/p headgear combination; Ben Coen rides, but the form string is consistently mid-pack without a win, and improvement is needed to figure.|
runners_data.comment: Nazario shaped with promise when runner-up five starts back and our rating of 83 puts him firmly in contention from stall 2, with experience over today's trip adding to his claims; the concern is a trainer without a winner in 27 attempts over the last fortnight.

runners_data.name: Venetian Star
runners_data.note: Front-runner whose best effort was a second over 7f on soft at the Curragh, but the wider form is weak (two 10th-place finishes) and she faces the same crowded early pace environment as every other leader in this race.|

races.paceDynamic: Snow Light, Motta Alta, Star Strewn, Glasarmi, and Venetian Star all want to lead in a 12-runner handicap on soft ground over 7f at Gowran, guaranteeing a genuinely searching gallop from the outset with no horse able to dictate unchallenged. The pace battle up front will drain the leaders early, and the soft ground will compound that energy cost significantly in the closing stages, stretching the field out and turning this into a thorough stamina examination. Cladach, a natural hold-up type, has been mapped to midfield because the field contains more hold-up runners than the race shape can accommodate at the rear, but its true profile is one that wants to come from off the pace — in a race this frenetic up front, genuine closers with stamina reserves will be best placed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven soft-ground form and the stamina to pick up tired rivals in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Closers Win
scenarios.trigger: If the contested early gallop burns out the front-running cluster and the race is truly run to suit horses finishing from off the pace.
scenarios.body: Multiple leaders press each other through the early stages on soft ground, and the field strings out entering the final two furlongs as the pace collapses; genuine hold-up horses with proven stamina and soft-ground credentials sweep through. Lohoobb and Ninth Crusade, both suited to coming late, are ideally placed to benefit from this shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Clears Field
scenarios.trigger: If Snow Light or Motta Alta gets a clear rail position early and the others burn each other out in the battle for second, leaving one leader to steal a march.
scenarios.body: With rivals fighting for position behind, one front-runner slips the field by a couple of lengths at halfway and the soft ground suits a relaxed, economical gallop rather than an all-out sprint; the horse that races most kindly in front conserves enough to hold on. Motta Alta's soft-ground form (1 win, 2 places in 3 soft starts) makes her the likeliest candidate to execute this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is fast enough to eliminate the true front-runners but not so extreme that hold-up horses sweep past, leaving a prominent-tracking horse to pick up the pieces.
scenarios.body: Solana Beach or Nazario, both tracking just off the pace in the first four or five, find the leaders weakening from the two-furlong pole and hit the front in a stride with momentum to spare. Solana Beach's two soft-ground placings and Seamie Heffernan's course craft make her particularly suited to this mid-race positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Outrun Softened Going
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is less fierce than anticipated and one of the leaders finds a soft rhythm, allowing a front-runner to still be competitive at the line on genuinely testing ground.
scenarios.body: A more measured early tempo would reduce the toll on Snow Light or Star Strewn, gifting them enough stamina to fight out the finish, though the weight of pace evidence makes this outcome the least likely. Star Strewn's sole win came on standard ground and soft-ground form is limited across the pace-setters, making this a lower-probability shape.

watchPoints.text: Snow Light, Motta Alta, Star Strewn, Glasarmi, and Venetian Star are all front-runners in a 12-runner field — watch the first furlong closely to see which horses actually secure their natural position and which are squeezed back, as that will immediately reshape the race.

Motta Alta's soft-ground record stands out among the pace-setters; if Shane Foley gets a clean break from the stalls and avoids the early scrimmage, she becomes significantly more dangerous than her OR of 79 implies.

Ninth Crusade raced just one day ago — watch for signs of a flat run as a result of the ultra-quick turnaround, which could undermine Colin Keane's ability to deliver the horse's usual hold-up challenge.

Lohoobb is the most straightforward hold-up profile in the race with a recent win at Goodwood and an in-form trainer angle; watch whether W J Lee gets a clear passage through the soft-ground field in the straight, as interference could cost him the race.

The soft going at Gowran has been consistent across all distances and times today — there is no evidence of any rail bias or drying strip that might benefit a particular draw or running style beyond what the pace map already captures.

races.name: Membership At Gowran Park Fillies Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Quinta Girl
runners_data.note: Shows a hold-up profile in her form but is shifted to midfield on the map because the rear of this race is over-subscribed; her recent soft-ground effort (3rd, 7f, Soft) is her best going angle, but racing in front of her natural position into a genuinely contested pace makes a big finish effort harder to land.
runners_data.comment: Quinta Girl has been placed third two starts back and shaped with promise in recent starts, and she has run over today's distance and going before; winless in her last five, the 74-day absence is the main concern.

runners_data.name: Tax Me Later
runners_data.note: Only one run to go on (3rd, 8f, Good) but OR of 120 makes her a class standout in this field; Nathan Crosse rides and the step to softer ground from good is unknown but the extra class gives her a meaningful structural edge tracking the pace.
runners_data.comment: Tax Me Later shaped with promise when third last time out, has run over today's trip, and her speed rating of 91 gives her a strong case from stall four; the main risk is that she remains yet to score and must convert that potential into a win here.

runners_data.name: Star Of Beauty
runners_data.note: Has run consistently on good-to-firm to good, placing twice over this 8f trip at this same course, suggesting she handles Gowran well; today's soft ground is a new query but her prominent running style and W J Lee aboard make her well-positioned to test it.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts, with back-to-back sixth-place finishes most recently, Star Of Beauty is hard to fancy on a rating ten pounds below official, though she has run over today's trip and the placed efforts earlier in this sequence hint at some ability.

runners_data.name: Profit Surge
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose recent form includes a win over 7f on Good and placed efforts on similar surfaces; sim-going record of 1 win from 15 on soft suggests softer ground may blunt her advantage, and contesting the lead with Minaun View will test her stamina reserves.
runners_data.comment: Profit Surge has run over today's trip and arrives on the back of a win last time out, but her recent record also shows a string of placed efforts without always converting, and 128 lb from stall 1 adds a further test of her claims.

runners_data.name: Keep It Together
runners_data.note: Flagged as a horse that fades in finishes, with a history of running over much longer trips (12f–16f) on good ground, suggesting this 1m soft test is unlikely to bring out her best; hold-up style with no recent form to encourage and a trainer showing 0/0 in the last 14 days.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last four starts, with back-to-back sixths her best recent efforts, Keep It Together ranks eighth of nine on our figures and faces a stiff ask here, though she has run over today's trip before and returns on a sound 17-day turnaround.

runners_data.name: Minaun View
runners_data.note: Genuine front-runner with recent wins over 7f and 8f on good, and wears a tongue-strap; trainer McGuinness is in form (2/21 last 14 days) and last ran only five days ago — her willingness to race again quickly and versatility in headgear suggests she could establish a solo lead if Profit Surge does not match her early stride.
runners_data.comment: A winner two starts back yet fifth last time out, Minaun View has experience over today's trip and going but returns just five days later, and her draw eight and 127 lb burden may make life tough for a filly ranked sixth of nine.

runners_data.name: Salamina
runners_data.note: Four consecutive double-figure finishes with a fade-in-finish flag and a Joseph O'Brien yard that is 12/72 in the last 14 days but this filly has shown nothing to suggest she can reverse a consistent pattern of well-beaten efforts at longer trips on good ground.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last four starts and ranked bottom of this field on our figures, Salamina faces a stiff ask from 132 lb out of stall six, though the seven-day turnaround suggests connections believe she retains fitness.

runners_data.name: Vlhova
runners_data.note: Two wins in her record including one from a similar position on Heathway going, but her last seven runs on good have produced 12 and 13 place finishes and her OR of 72 gives no class edge; wears a tongue-tie and has not run for 35 days — a hold-up type who needs things to fall right.
runners_data.comment: Twice placed three and four starts back, Vlhova heads here on a 35-day break with distance and going experience in her favour, and an 80 rating that just edges her to the top of these; winless in her last five, she needs to convert that placed form into something more decisive.

runners_data.name: Una Matata
runners_data.note: Showed a win over 7f on standard and has recently been placed at 7f and 8f on standard and good; prominent style means she can slot in just off the front-runners and her five-year-old experience over today's trip is useful, though 67 days off the track is a minor stamina-fitness query.
runners_data.comment: Una Matata showed smart form when winning five starts back, and her experience over today's distance and going keeps her firmly in the mix carrying 129 lb from stall nine; the main risk is a 67-day absence leaving her short of peak fitness.

races.paceDynamic: Profit Surge and Minaun View are both confirmed front-runners and will contest the lead from the gates, creating a genuinely competitive early pace over this flat Gowran mile on soft ground — neither will surrender readily, with Colin Keane aboard Profit Surge and Patrick McGettigan on Minaun View both likely to press forward. The resulting honest-to-strong gallop on soft turf will drain stamina reserves early, making it harder for front-runners to simply coast and quicken, and extending the race into the final two furlongs in a way that tests finishing reserves. Prominent types like Tax Me Later, Star Of Beauty, and Una Matata sit ideally poised to travel into the race without burning energy, close enough to capitalise if the leaders weaken without needing to cover excessive ground. This race shape therefore favours prominently-raced horses who can track a genuine pace and sustain their effort in the soft — true hold-up horses sitting deep face an unfavourable shape with limited room for momentum. The field contains more front-running and prominent types than the map fully accommodates; Quinta Girl, a genuine hold-up type, is mapped to midfield precisely because the rear is crowded by redistribution, meaning she is unlikely to achieve natural late-closing position and her chance is structurally discounted.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Profit Surge and Minaun View fight for supremacy and honest early fractions drain both, allowing a tracking prominent horse to take over in the straight.
scenarios.body: The soft ground amplifies the cost of a contested lead, leaving the two front-runners vulnerable as they enter the final two furlongs, while horses settled just off them capitalise on saved energy. Tax Me Later, Star Of Beauty, and Una Matata are best placed to exploit this shape, having the positional speed to travel close to the pace without being consumed by it.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dictates Softly
scenarios.trigger: If Minaun View or Profit Surge establishes an uncontested lead early while the other fades or settles, creating a steady, controlled gallop.
scenarios.body: A sole dictator controlling their own rhythm on soft ground can dictate tempo and deny closers a truly punishing gallop to chase, staying competitive into the straight. Minaun View, who has won at this trip and recently won over 8f on good, is the more likely beneficiary given trainer McGuinness's recent form and her versatility with headgear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves truly strong and the field strings out, leaving room for deep-lying runners to find clear passage and pick up in the soft ground.
scenarios.body: Soft going does theoretically reward staying power from hold-up types, and if the leaders genuinely empty, Vlhova or Quinta Girl could find late momentum — though Quinta Girl is displaced from her natural position and Vlhova's recent form has been poor. This is a lower-probability shape because the presumed hold-up horses either lack recent form or are not genuinely racing from the rear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Field Bunches, Melee Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is misjudged or collapses mid-race, causing the field to bunch and produce a blanket finish with multiple runners finding upsides.
scenarios.body: In a compressed, scrappy finish on soft ground class and positional luck become decisive, and horses with higher ORs like Tax Me Later and Star Of Beauty hold a residual class edge over claim-level rivals. Keep It Together and Salamina have both shown a tendency to fade in finishes, reducing their relevance even in an open scenario.

watchPoints.text: Profit Surge and Minaun View — watch from the gates to see who takes the lead; if both press hard from the off on soft ground, neither may last into the final furlong and the race shape becomes critical for prominent trackers.

Tax Me Later — her OR of 120 is the highest in the field by a considerable margin, making her the class angle, but with only one run on record the lack of soft-ground evidence means her actual ability to handle today's conditions is a genuine unknown.

Quinta Girl — despite being mapped to midfield, she is a natural hold-up horse and may drift back toward the rear instinctively; if the race is run at a genuine gallop she will need a gap to appear at the right moment, which is far from guaranteed.

Minaun View — watch her post-race condition given she ran only five days ago; if she appears to be doing well at the start and jumps cleanly, her ability to dictate a solo lead makes her a key race-shaper whose influence extends far beyond her own chance.

Star Of Beauty — fitted with a visor and has placed twice over this exact course and trip; watch for W J Lee to place her prominently early, as she is the horse most likely to benefit quietly if both front-runners burn each other off.

races.name: Societies Welcome At Gowran Park Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Navajo Point
runners_data.note: Hold-up operator who has struggled for a finish in recent starts, with the fade flag reinforced by poor soft-going form (1 place from 8 runs); 17 days since last run, no headgear change, and this flat soft-ground mile looks unlikely to elicit a different result.
runners_data.comment: Navajo Point arrives here 17 days fresh, has run over today's trip and going, and that runner-up last time out puts him in decent heart; winless in his last five starts yet drawn in stall two carrying 142 lb, his latest effort makes him a compelling each-way proposition.

runners_data.name: Selective Power
runners_data.note: Seven-year-old hold-up type returning from 81 days off; best soft-ground record in this field (10 runs, one win, two places) but recent form strings include multiple non-completions and the layoff is a concern in soft conditions.
runners_data.comment: Selective Power has shown glimpses of ability with two fourth-place finishes in his last five starts, and he has run over today's distance and going before, but 81 days off the track is a concern and he remains winless in recent starts.

runners_data.name: Volendam
runners_data.note: The lone front-runner and race-shape anchor; STYLE_FIT flag signals this horse is operating out of its most comfortable role, having historically shown hold-up tendencies, but in this field it is likely to go forward by default and control a modest pace.
runners_data.comment: Volendam ran a solid second two starts back and has experience of today's distance and going in her favour, with 29 days since her last run suggesting she returns fresh; the unplaced effort last time out is the chief concern.

runners_data.name: Medieval Night
runners_data.note: Hold-up type for Hogan, 20 days since last run with tongue-tie and blinkers; all recent form on good ground and the soft conditions represent a question mark, though the staying profile over a mile could help if the pace is strong enough.
runners_data.comment: Medieval Night has shown flashes of ability — placed second last time out and third six starts back — but a sixth and seventh in between highlight his inconsistency, and he remains yet to win in recent starts; 141 lb from stall 15 adds to the challenge.

runners_data.name: Mags

races.paceDynamic: Volendam is the sole confirmed front-runner in a 19-runner field on soft ground at Gowran Park, and with no genuine pressure anticipated, this horse is set to control proceedings from the front at a sustainable, energy-conserving tempo dictated by the conditions. Carvalhal, Rampage, Bright Dick, and Tempted Angel are the next likely positions behind the leader, with several runners — including Crosshaven, Lust, Limbocall, and others — nominally mapped to midfield but whose natural instinct is to race further back; the field holds more prominent and hold-up types than the race shape can accommodate, and those most likely to genuinely secure a forward position are Carvalhal and Rampage. Soft ground over a mile with one honest front-runner and a compressed midfield means the race will be run at a measured pace through the first half before the tempo lifts from the home turn, with the field bunching and creating a wide finishing band. This shape most favours prominent horses and those racing in the first half-dozen who can travel into the pace rather than those relying on a late burst from the rear, as the soft ground will blunt the acceleration of true hold-up types in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Volendam Controls, Prominent Win
scenarios.trigger: If Volendam establishes a comfortable lead and the pace remains measured throughout, front-to-prominent types are handed a decisive positional advantage.
scenarios.body: Volendam sets a soft-ground-friendly tempo with no challenger, allowing horses travelling just off the leader to conserve energy before delivering their effort from two furlongs out. Carvalhal, who has won on soft and placed prominently, and Rampage, who races prominently, are ideally placed to pounce on any weakness from the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Front Pair Clear
scenarios.trigger: If the overly-slow early tempo creates a sprint finish from the front two, horses with tactical speed who have raced handy dominate.
scenarios.body: A crawl early on soft ground means the winner never leaves the front rank, with the finishing burst beginning three furlongs out and rewarding those with a prominent pitch and residual speed. Carvalhal and Bright Dick, both prominent types, have the profile to grind out a soft-ground finish without needing a sharp late kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Drifter Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough to string the field out and tire the leaders, horses with stamina who travel through the pack can reach the principals.
scenarios.body: A genuine pace collapse from the front runners opens a gap for those who have been covered up in the first half of the field to make sustained headway entering the straight. Lady Kelly, with soft-ground form, and Medieval Night have the stamina profile for this scenario, though several midfield runners here are redistributed hold-up types unlikely to truly close.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: True Closer Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves strong and the ground takes maximum toll on prominent runners, a horse with genuine late-running ability overcomes positional disadvantage.
scenarios.body: This scenario requires the early tempo to be much stronger than anticipated and the soft ground to severely punish those who have raced forward, creating a genuine late-running opportunity. Most of the nominal hold-up runners here are redistributed types rather than true closers, reducing the likelihood materially.

watchPoints.text: Carvalhal has the standout soft-going record in this race (1 win, 3 places from 8 soft-ground starts) and races prominently — if Volendam sets a comfortable pace, Burns's 2lb claim and a positive race shape put this horse in a very dangerous position.

Volendam carries a STYLE_FIT flag indicating it is racing out of its natural role as front-runner — monitor its early behaviour at the start and in the opening furlong, as any reluctance to go forward immediately inverts the expected race shape.
Bright Dick's 782-day absence is extreme and, combined with a tongue-strap, makes this horse impossible to assess reliably — if it shows unexpected early speed it could disrupt the pace map entirely.

Lady Kelly is the highest-rated hold-up runner with plausible soft-ground form; if the pace quickens sharply from two out and front horses tire, she is the most credible representative of the stay-and-pounce profile.

Rampage runs just seven days after its last start — monitor for any market moves that suggest connections are confident fitness is not a concern, as its prominent style makes it a natural fit for the pace scenario that is most likely to unfold.

races.paceDynamic: Faoladh is the lone confirmed front-runner in a 19-runner field and, with no genuine rival willing to press him for the lead, he should dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop around Gowran's flat mile on soft ground. She's Ideal and Gloriously Glam will push forward into prominent positions just behind him, ensuring at least a compact lead group without anyone burning the race apart. The bulk of the field — Unidos, Rhythm King, Navagio, Merciless, Cosmic Funk, Aurora Mist, Yutori and others — are natural hold-up types who have been mapped to midfield purely because the rear is over-subscribed; those runners will not find their true position and most will race closer than ideal. With an uncontested, measured pace on soft ground over a flat mile, this race shape strongly favours horses racing prominently or from just off the pace who can travel into the contest and kick from two out, rather than pure closers who need a strong gallop to be set up for them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Faoladh Dictates, Prominent Win
scenarios.trigger: If Faoladh bowls along at a comfortable clip and the soft ground saps energy from those racing in behind without a true pace injection.
scenarios.body: Faoladh controls proceedings from the front and the race is run at a tempo that suits horses racing in the first four or five, with She's Ideal and Gloriously Glam able to travel powerfully into the straight and challenge off a genuine rhythm; soft ground rewards those already on the bridle into the home turn.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Faoladh Outstays Field
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and Faoladh's controlled fractions mean the leader is never seriously challenged and simply outstays a fatigued field.
scenarios.body: Faoladh converts his positional advantage into a straightforward front-running success as the field strings out on testing ground and those held up never get close enough; his recent course win on good and willingness to front-run on a flat track are the key credentials.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Mover Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is fractionally stronger than expected — perhaps She's Ideal or Gloriously Glam push on earlier — creating enough gallop for a well-positioned midfield horse to pick them off.
scenarios.body: A horse sitting fifth to eighth who gets a clear run from two furlongs out benefits from rivals having done too much work in soft ground, and the winner emerges from the group just behind the prominent runners rather than from the rear; Suir Monad, with three consecutive placed efforts and soft-ground form, is the logical candidate from this pocket.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace genuinely collapses in the final two furlongs and a true hold-up horse manages to get a clear run from deep to mow down a tiring leader.
scenarios.body: This scenario is structurally unlikely because the redistribution means most nominal hold-up types will not settle far enough back to produce a sustained late run, and the flat Gowran mile on soft ground rarely produces dramatic finishes from the rear; Goofy Gander or Bill Silvers represent the best profiles if it materialises, though their finishing-line records are modest.

watchPoints.text: Faoladh is unchallenged for the lead — if he slides into a very slow early rhythm on soft ground, the prominent horses behind him will save maximum energy and simply outkick him, making the sectionals in the first three furlongs the critical watch point.

She's Ideal drops in trip from her three winning runs over ten furlongs; if she travels strongly in the first furlong and secures a prominent position just off Faoladh, she becomes the most potent shape-aligned challenger in the race.

Gloriously Glam with Colin Keane aboard must find a clear passage in a 19-runner field — if she gets shuffled back at the start or loses prominent ground on the first bend, the race shape no longer suits her profile.

Andrew Slattery saddles three runners (Faoladh, Aurora Mist, Suir Monad) — watch for any tactical coordination between them in running, particularly whether Suir Monad is given a prominent or waiting brief, which will signal stable intentions.

The volume of redistributed hold-up horses racing out of role means the middle to rear of the field will be congested for much of the trip — any horse drawn wide that fails to secure early position may be travelling in a pocket for longer than ideal on soft ground.

races.paceDynamic: Navy Guitar is the sole confirmed front-runner in a 17-runner field on soft ground over 1m6f at Gowran Park, and with a 325-day absence to his name he is unlikely to be pressured into a suicidal gallop — Gavin Ryan can dictate a measured, energy-conserving tempo from the front. Antrim Coast, Banbridge, Dee Bee Zed, Thisistheway and Bartholomew all carry prominent-running profiles and will push forward from the gates, meaning the early sections will be competitively occupied even if no single horse hunts Navy Guitar down aggressively. The field holds more hold-up types than the race shape can accommodate at the rear — Goodie Girl, Fraher Field, Figero and Ballybawn Belter are natural closers who are likely to find themselves racing closer to the pace than ideal, diluting their finishing kicks. A sustainable, honest gallop on soft ground over this stamina trip strongly favours prominent racers with proven soft-ground credentials who can travel within themselves in the first mile and then pick up from a good position — genuine out-and-out hold-up horses face a structural disadvantage in this shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent types dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Navy Guitar sets an honest but uncontested pace and the prominent pack tracks comfortably within themselves through the first mile.
scenarios.body: The soft ground and stamina trip ensure the race only truly tests horses from the home turn, rewarding those who have settled in a handy position without burning energy fighting for the rail; Antrim Coast, Banbridge and Thisistheway all fit this profile with proven soft-ground records and the mileage to stay on.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Navy Guitar is allowed to bowl along at a deceptive clip and the field is lulled into chasing too late.
scenarios.body: On soft ground over 1m6f a lone leader who controls tempo completely can steal a march around the final bend, and with no confirmed pressing rival Navy Guitar's race fitness question is offset by his tactical freedom; horses taken wide or held up have the most ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Closers get home late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack over-exerts chasing Navy Guitar mid-race and the gallop picks up enough to string the field out and leave those closers with genuine daylight.
scenarios.body: Western Fold and Ballybawn Belter both carry strong soft-ground and stamina profiles and are true hold-up types who would benefit if the pace collapses the prominent group; however, several redistributed hold-up horses will be racing closer than ideal, making a clean late run harder to execute.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina test grinds them
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground deteriorates further through the card and the race becomes a true slog from halfway, eliminating speedier prominent types.
scenarios.body: A true stamina grind over 1m6f on deep soft would suit a genuine stayer with soft-ground form — Western Fold's wins on soft at extreme trips make him relevant here — but this scenario requires conditions to be significantly worse than what the going report currently reflects.

watchPoints.text: Navy Guitar has been off 325 days — watch in the pre-parade ring and early in the race for any signs of rustiness, as his ability to control tempo cleanly from the front is the single biggest structural factor shaping this race.

Nothingbutadream ran just one day ago and carries a "fades in finish" flag in a soft-ground stamina race — watch for whether she is withdrawn or whether she struggles badly in running, as a tired horse blocking the rail could disrupt runners behind her.

The cluster of prominent types — Antrim Coast, Banbridge, Dee Bee Zed and Thisistheway — will all attempt to press forward early; watch the first two furlongs for any scrimmaging or horses being forced wider than ideal, which could set up a messy pace dynamic rather than the orderly shape Navy Guitar's connections would prefer.

Western Fold returns after 126 days for Gordon Elliott whose yard is at 1/36 over 14 days — watch for any market drift in the final hour as a guide to whether connections are confident about fitness, given his soft-ground credentials make him potentially dangerous if cherry ripe.

Figero, Goodie Girl, Fraher Field and Ballybawn Belter are all redistributed hold-up types likely racing closer than ideal — watch whether jockeys attempt to drop them out anyway and whether they get caught in traffic on the home turn, a common hazard with multiple closers unable to find their natural position.
